crm_notes: SMB devtool startup building an in-editor code assistant. Long context is primary ask (multi-file, 50-200KB). Highly price-sensitive at early stage - wants to keep inference cost < $0.02/session. Quote from CTO on call: 'We need to stitch entire repo context into a single session and keep latency < 1s for token response after priming.' Typical usage: background indexing + live assistant, bursts during PR reviews. Interested in Hosted API for fast time-to-value, may evaluate Dedicated if scale justifies. Currently testing with 2-3 devs, expect to scale to 50 seats in 6-12 months if cost/latency acceptable.
